items.title: Wellman Braud Interview, 1958-03-31
items.q: Who's that boy from the Orleans play with Reed Allen?

ctx.x: If there's anything else you want to hear, otherwise, anytime you want to go, we can drive back. That boy is a shock, he's a great drummer too, the one drop paid, Brunus boy. Oh yeah. That'd be Brunus. Or some drummer. I can tell you about drummers.

That kid turned New York upside down. Who's that boy from the Orleans play with Reed Allen? He's some drummer too. I don't know. He make them fellas like Cozy Cozy and them sound bad. Zooty, if that play sound bad, they make them sound awfully bad. Who is, when was this, recently? Oh, he was a drummer. That guy's a drummer.
But I don't like radio on band.
